texto.muro: a wall of raw board-formed concrete with the grain of the planks still printed in it

escena: SCENE (art direction pass, studio in Bogota, morning): the marked proof lies on a dark walnut worktop in the LOWER portion of the frame, lit by a hard shaft of window light that rakes across it and stops there; the reserved concrete wall above stands in its own even shadow, with no beam, no window and no bright spot crossing it. The ink-blue halftone fields of the proof give the picture its blue. Caught AT THE INSTANT the grease pencil is lifted away and the last stroke is still wet and raised on the paper. 50mm at f/4, camera looking slightly down. Everything is completely unbranded.

lecho.objeto: the near edge of the walnut worktop immediately under the lens
